note: Generated by tools/p01-spike/build-inventory.mjs from the pinned Codewhale 0.10.2 surface. P18 reconciled every row through tools/p18-coverage/reconcile.mjs: description, scope, exact invocation, help source, an explicit entry point (kind/target/label/tested), current status, and a named gap where no faithful route exists. Coverage is computed from the rows, never asserted: a feature Mona cannot reach stays visible and blocks parity. P13 added change receipts, Git review, and one-file native restore; P15 qualified orchestration; P17 qualified extensions; P18 added the integrated terminal, command palette, and capability explorer, and recorded checked-in workflows and lane management as blocked gaps because 0.10.2 exposes no /v1 route for them.
